data.title: FAQ
data.tagline: Answer common questions before visitors need to ask
data.description: A FAQ section handles repeated questions about price, setup, policy, or fit. Write questions in the visitor's language and answer them directly. If the same question needs a long explanation, link to a full guide instead of hiding an article inside an accordion.

use: Clarify details that do not fit the main story
avoid: Use the FAQ to hide essential product information
Write promotional answers that avoid the question
Place long documentation inside every answer

lessonPractice.title: Support records show repeated questions about refund windows and data security. How should the site FAQ organize them?

options.label: Use the real questions as headings, answer with the conclusion first, then conditions and a next-step link
options.feedback: Real questions address actual concerns, a conclusion answers quickly, and conditions plus links support follow-up.

options.label: Rewrite them as Why are we the best choice? and use the answers to list product strengths
options.feedback: Promotional self-questioning does not resolve the concrete issues repeatedly reaching support and weakens trust.

options.label: Put refund limits only deep inside FAQ answers and remove them from the purchase area
options.feedback: FAQ can add detail, but a condition that affects purchase should not depend on users discovering a hidden answer.

data.agentPrompt: Build the FAQ from support records rather than invented promotional questions. Start every answer with its conclusion, then add conditions and a documentation or action link. Keep purchase-critical details such as refund windows visible near pricing and CTAs.
